title: subagent: Find APOD and architectural firm

content:
I'm having trouble with web tools in my environment. I need you to help me answer a GAIA benchmark question. You have access to bash, websearch, webfetch, read, write, and other tools.

The question: During the first week of August 2015, one of the NASA Astronomy Pictures of the Day shows the lights of a city on the horizon. The namesake of this city also has a landmark building in Chicago named after him. What is the name of the architectural firm that designed this landmark building? Give the first name appearing in the name of the firm as of June 2023.

Please do the following research using websearch and webfetch:
1. Find the APOD from August 1-7, 2015 that shows city lights on the horizon. Try fetching from https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap150801.html through ap150807.html
2. Identify the city whose lights are shown
3. Find who the city is named after (its namesake)
4. Find what landmark building in Chicago is named after that person
5. Find what architectural firm designed that building
6. Give the first name in the firm's name as of June 2023

Please use websearch to find information and webfetch to read pages. Report all your findings.
I'll help you solve this GAIA benchmark question step by step. Let me start by fetching the APODs from August 1-7, 2015 to find the one showing city lights on the horizon.
